blockers.summary: Backend not wired to fixture DB — seed import source not present; all browser tests blocked
blockers.detail: The backend is running against the LIVE database instead of the fixture DB built by build_qa_fixture_db.py. The three required environment variables (TRENDORA_ENABLE_SEED_IMPORT_SOURCE, TRENDORA_CONFIG, TRENDORA_SEED_IMPORT_DIR) are not set. This is the iter-23/24/25/26 recurrence pattern that prevents all four target journeys from being reachable.
blockers.next_action: Restart backend with fixture env values; then re-run browser tests TC-01 through TC-12
